metadata.title: नक्सल इलाका कैसा दिखता है | Life in India’s Most Inaccessible Naxal Stronghold | Main Bhi Bharat
metadata.description: Abujhmad — the name itself evokes mystery, fear, and resilience. Known as the last stronghold of Naxals, this dense forest in Chhattisgarh remains one of India’s most inaccessible and least understood regions. Our team travels deep into this rugged terrain to bring you a rare glimpse of life inside Abujhmad — where survival is a daily struggle and every step tells a story of courage, deprivation, and endurance. Watch this exclusive ground report to understand how people live, move, and hope in a place cut off from the rest of the world.
